spans.s: + नन्दन नलिनी- + नन्दन, n. a garden of Kuvera,

† नल् नल्, i. 1, Par. To smell; to bind (?).
 --i. 10, Par. To speak, or to shine.

नल (for नड, q. cf.), m.
 1. A kind of reed, Amphidonax karka Lindl.,
; the hero of the episode Nala and Damayantī.

नाल, i. e. नल + अ,
 I. adj. Consisting of reed, Bhāg.

.
 II. n.
 1. A hollow or tubular stalk, especially the stalk of the water-lily,
. A tubular vessel of the body,

.
 III. f. ला, The name of a river,

नलद,
 1. n. (and f. दा), The Indian spikenard, Nardostachys jatamansi,
. n. The root of the Andropogon muricatus,

नलिन, i. e. नल + इन,
 I. n. A lotus flower,

.
 II. f. नी,
 1. A lotus, Nelumbium speciosum,

. An assemblage of lotus flowers, Vikr. d. 5.
 3. A pond in which the lotus grows or may grow,
. A branch of the heavenly Ganges,
. A mystical name of one of the nostrils, Bhāg.
-नलिनी + क, A substitute for नलिनी, as latter part of a comp. adj., Bhāg.
नल्व, perhaps नत + व, cf. नड्वल, m. A furlong, a distance measured by four hundred (?) cubits,
नालाय, a denomin. derived from नाल with य, ptcple. of the pf. pass. नालायित, Representing the handle of an axe, Bhāg.
नालिकेर, and नालिकेल नालिकेल, m. The cocoa-nut,
नालिनी, i. e. नाल + इन् + ई, f. A mystical name of one of the nostrils, Bhāg.
नालीक, i. e. नाल + ईक, m. A kind of arrow,
+ सेतु नल- + सेतु, m. the bridge constructed by the monkey Nala, name of the islands between India and Ceylon,
